title: NeoChord TACT Post-Market Surveillance Registry
brief_summary: To monitor the long-term performance of the CE Marked NeoChord Artificial Chordae Delivery System
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Grade 3+ or 4+ mitral valve regurgitation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Heavily calcified valves
* Valvular retraction with severely reduced mobility
* Active bacterial endocarditis
* Complex mechanism of MR (leaflet perforation, etc.)
* Significant tethering of leaflets
* Inflammatory valve disease
study_population: Patients with Grade 3+ or 4+ mitral valve regurgitation who are candidates for surgical mitral valve repair or replacement
